releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.49 — the two reflexes every WhatsApp user has, plus a faster ear. Swipe any message to the right and a reply arrow slides in at its edge; let go past the halfway point and the composer quotes it, without opening the menu. Double-tap a message and the love reaction lands on it immediately (tap it again to take it back). Long voice notes now carry the 1× / 1.5× / 2× control at the end of the bar — tap to speed up, tap again for 2×, once more for normal — and the speed is applied the moment playback starts, so a six-minute note takes three minutes. Vertical scrolling over a bubble still scrolls the chat: the swipe only claims horizontal movement.
